items.summary: Implement backend (Motoko) Question Gallery APIs to support full CRUD for questions, including: create a new question, list questions filtered by subject, update an existing question, and delete a question. Enforce admin-only access for create/update/delete and allow authenticated users to read/list questions.
Add persistent stable storage for Question Gallery data so questions (and associated counters/indices needed for listing and CRUD) survive canister upgrades/redeploys.

Support storing and returning question images for gallery questions using the existing blob-storage mixin (Storage.ExternalBlob fields already present in Question/Option types). Provide backend methods needed by the frontend to attach uploaded images to a question (question-level image and option-level image).

Wire the AdminPanel Question Gallery UI to the real backend Question Gallery APIs by updating React Query hooks and components so that selecting a subject loads questions from the backend instead of returning an empty stub.

Add Admin UI support for creating and editing gallery questions (including optional images) within the existing AdminPanel QuestionManagementPanel flow, and connect it to the new backend create/update APIs.
